name: R5.4 Route quote approval by value and discount

nodes.name: Step 1: Quote awaiting approval
nodes.notes: Your CRM calls this when a quote is set "awaiting approval". Body: {quote_id, revision}.

nodes.name: Step 8: Decision recorded
nodes.notes: Your CRM calls this when an approver records a decision. Body: {quote_id, revision, decision: approved|rejected, by, comment}.

nodes.name: Step 7: Each hour
nodes.notes: Step 7's deadline check.

nodes.name: Backstop: Each week
nodes.notes: The declared backstop where the CRM cannot lock quotes (runs each Monday).

assignments.value: <link to your copy of Book 1's Checklist 13.1, the quote approver's check>

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 3: Recompute from the CRM record
nodes.notes: Value after discount, largest line discount, multi-year, off-list and non-standard flags; never the quote text.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'back to R5.3', locked: true, return_reason: 'price list ' + $json.stamped + ' replaced by ' + $json.list_version }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Read the quote').first().json.salesperson, subject: 'Quote ' + $('Step 1: Quote awaiting approval').first().json.body.quote_id + ' back to drafting', text: 'The price list it was drafted from is no longer current; mark the opportunity ready to quote again to redraft it.' }) }}

nodes.name: Step 5: Rule: Table 5.1
nodes.notes: The rule decides who approves; nobody else can.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ locked: true, approver: $json.approver, deputy: $json.deputy, approval_level: $json.level, deadline_hours: $json.deadline_hours, requested_at: $json.requested_at, escalation: 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Step 6: Lock and record the approver
nodes.notes: Locked where the CRM can; only approval unlocks sending.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Step 5: Rule: Table 5.1').first().json.approver, subject: 'Approve quote ' + $('Step 1: Quote awaiting approval').first().json.body.quote_id + ' revision ' + $('Step 1: Quote awaiting approval').first().json.body.revision, text: 'Value after discount ' + $('Step 3: Recompute from the CRM record').first().json.value + '; largest line discount ' + $('Step 3: Recompute from the CRM record').first().json.largest_discount + '%; ' + $('Step 5: Rule: Table 5.1').first().json.why + '. Record your decision in the CRM within ' + $('Step 5: Rule: Table 5.1').first().json.deadline_hours + ' hours.', checklist: $('Config').first().json.checklist }) }}
